svg.text: Y name is Akshat Bhaskar. I love building things and
dragging good ideas out into the open where people can
use them. I would love to talk about Economics,
Mathematics, Public Policy, Anthropology, and Philosophy.
OME interesting things about me are:
- I was once awarded by the President of India.
- I am really interested in the mission of financial literacy.
- I took a gap year after high school.
- I have conducted research, published and presented.
- I am always doing a LOT of things.
